selfSufficiency.notes: Data limited. High fish consumption (83.8 kg/capita, ~3x Norway). Import dependent for most non-seafood products.

breakdown.notes: Sheep farming and dairy significant. Geothermal greenhouses (tomatoes, cucumbers) are unique to Iceland. Fish is dominant sector.

steps.name: Sjømat
steps.notes: World's most technologically advanced whitefish processing (Marel technology). Key export sector. Samherji is largest company.

concentration.notes: Hagar dominates. 80% of consumers report competition problems.

data_quality: Low. Significant gaps across all value chain steps. Priority for data harvest.
